question.text: The equivalent weight of $\mathrm{K}_{2} \mathrm{Cr}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{7}$ in acidic medium is expressed in terms of its molecular weight (M) as

solution.text:
In acidic medium,
$$
\mathrm{K}_{2} \mathrm{Cr}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{7} \longrightarrow \mathrm{Cr}^{3+}
$$
Equivalent weight of $\mathrm{K}_{2} \mathrm{Cr}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{7}=\frac{\text { Molecular weight }}{\text { Change in oxidation state of } \mathrm{c}}$
$$
=\frac{M}{2(6-3)}=\frac{M}{6}
$$
